theme: Lambeth Local Plan 2029 temporal and source-precedence guard
facts: Lambeth published notice of intention to commence a new Local Plan on 16 July 2026.
The decision to commence was made on 30 June 2026.
The new plan is named Lambeth Local Plan 2029.
The plan area is the London Borough of Lambeth administrative boundary.
Preparation is expected to begin on 31 October 2026.
The notice is made under Regulation 19 of the 2026 Local Planning Regulations.
A Call for Sites ran 19 January to 20 March 2026.
Call-for-Sites submissions are potential development land, not adopted allocations.
Call-for-Sites submissions may be considered for inclusion in future allocations.
SADPD and Local Plan 2029 are different temporal planning processes.
SADPD proposed-site status must not be silently upgraded to adopted status.
Local Plan 2029 commencement does not itself create parcel-level designation.
Candidate parcel_61522 needs target-polygon evidence from the relevant current or proposed allocation source.
Temporal status must be stored with every future-growth binding.
Later replacement policy must not be back-applied before its legal/effective stage.
